desc:
Pointer's Sporting Series 12 Gauge over/under shotgun is ideal for shooting both clays and birds. Enjoy the premium crafstmanship coupled with time-tested accuracy when you purchase this classy, unique shotgun that takes you back in time.

The shotgun features a break-action with a 2 round capacity - one round for each barrel.

The stock and forend are made of durable Turkish Grade 2 walnut wood.

The barrel is 28 inches in length, and the overall firearm length is 45 inches.

The gun's weight without added modifications or shells inserted is 7.5 lbs.

Featuring a raised vent rib and a fiber optic sight for precise, on the fly shots. The crisp mechanical trigger will result in a quick, prompt shot. To top it off, the receiver side-plate features raised gold mallards for a traditional, high class appearance.
